meta.name: Recipe: Feedback Trails
meta.description: Trails done the contract section 8 way: a scene-level feedback decay multiplies the previous frame before this frame draws, so additively-blended movers leave smooth glowing streaks. A small set of orbiting dots sweep the canvas; with a high decay they smear into ribbons, with a low decay they stay crisp. Decay rises a little with energy so louder passages streak longer, and brightness is energy-gated so the trails fade to a calm dark wash in silence.
